proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: induction on n reduces to the case where all g_i lie on one connected component (a clopen decomposition splits the problem into two disjoint affine opens whose disjoint union is affine); translating by g_1^{-1} puts the points in G^0 (0B7R); irreducibility of G^0 makes the finite intersection of translates U g_i^{-1} nonempty, and local finite type over the algebraically closed field gives a rational point g in the intersection, so all g_i lie in the affine open g^{-1}U (source lines 1553-1579)
